blocks.t: This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains how cancellations, refunds, credits, and booking changes are handled when using the Palmera platform.

Because Palmera partners with independent businesses, each Provider establishes its own cancellation and refund policy. These policies are displayed to users before a reservation or booking is confirmed.
By completing a booking through Palmera, you acknowledge and agree to the applicable Provider’s cancellation and refund policy.
Each Provider on Palmera is responsible for determining its own:
These terms are displayed during the booking process and may differ from one Provider to another.
Certain bookings made through Palmera are reservation-only and do not require payment through the platform.
Any cancellation or reservation questions should be directed to the Provider unless otherwise indicated.
For bookings that require payment through Palmera, the applicable Provider’s cancellation and refund policy will govern the transaction.
If you choose to cancel a booking, your eligibility for a refund, partial refund, credit, or rescheduling will depend entirely on the Provider’s published cancellation policy.
If a refund is approved, it will generally be processed back to your original payment method.
Processing times may vary depending on your payment provider or financial institution.
If a Provider cancels a confirmed booking, Palmera will work with both parties to determine the most appropriate resolution.

Nothing in this section guarantees a refund.
Where applicable, service fees charged by Palmera may be non-refundable unless otherwise required by applicable law or expressly stated during checkout.
If you fail to arrive for a booked experience without cancelling in accordance with the applicable Provider’s policy, you may not be eligible for a refund.
No-show policies are determined by each Provider and are displayed before booking.

Palmera cannot guarantee that modifications will be possible after a booking has been confirmed.
Users are encouraged to contact Palmera before initiating a payment dispute or chargeback with their financial institution.
Palmera reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts involved in fraudulent or abusive chargeback activity.
If a booking is cancelled and refunded, any Palmera Points earned from that transaction may be reduced, reversed, or removed from the user’s account.
If Palmera Points were redeemed as part of the booking, they may be restored only in accordance with the applicable refund outcome.
